page.layout: One printed page: running head at top centre; page number top left; a central engraving (emblem picture) with a motto inscription inside it; below the picture a verse of four lines in italic; a catchword-like signature "De" at lower right.

main_text.head: SPIRITUALE MELLIFICIVM. Ex minimis magna.
main_text.p: [engraving: sun with face above an open book bearing the motto "Lux lucet in tenebris / At non comprehendit eam"; beehives on a platform before a city and hills; described under notes]

p.i: Quam suauis liquor est verbum, bone Christe, tuum mi!
Hoc age perpetuo tantum mea corda rigentur,
Et capient animos taedia nulla meos.

page.notes: The engraving shows a sun with a face above an open book; the visible inscription in the book is partly illegible ("Lux lucet in tenebris" / "At non comprehendit eam" are only partly readable, so I have not transcribed them as text). Three beehives stand on a stone platform with a city and hills behind. The word "De" at lower right is a signature-like mark, kept as printed. Several letters in the verse are hard to read at the scan resolution but appear as printed.
